overview: The committee reviewed progress on comprehensive zoning ordinance revisions, focusing on site plan review structures and definition updates, and received an educational presentation from Massachusetts Housing Partnership on affordable housing financing and development.

items.title: Zoning Ordinance Recodification Updates
items.summary: Zoning consultant Emily Innes outlined upcoming revisions to definitions, use tables, and site plan review frameworks, and the committee discussed establishing administrative review options for minor projects.

items.title: Affordable Housing Training by Mass Housing Partnership
items.summary: Representatives from Massachusetts Housing Partnership presented on housing affordability data, development financing complexities, and municipal tools, after which the committee voted to receive the presentation and place it on file.
